name: Dynamic Sparse Voxel Octree with Morton Codes
aliases: Dynamic Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) with Morton Codes
definition: A single-header C++ implementation of a dynamic sparse voxel octree using integer coordinates and Morton codes, micro-optimized for CPU-based voxel physics simulations in chunked procedural game worlds.
summary: Dynamic Sparse Voxel Octree with Morton Codes is a CPU-optimized data structure for high-throughput bulk voxel insertion, removal, and querying in procedural game worlds.
